target_statement: For any Valid certificate whose initial phase is SixPhase, prove the temporal phase-code profile: for every i, sixCode((cert.st i).c) = (sixCode((cert.st 0).c)+i) % 6; consequently, because valid_period_mod6 gives 6 | cert.P, every one of the six phase classes {2,4,8,16,14,10} occurs exactly cert.P/6 times among st 0,...,st(P-1). This is a temporal/column restriction distinct from the existing saturation-composition period lower bounds and does not claim certificate existence or anything specific to 196.
dependencies: official Lean 4.19.0 environment as pinned by repository
remaining_obligation: Formalize and verify the exact per-time phase-code identity and exact six-class counts; audit axioms and clean-build before any acceptance label.
